title: Questionnaire Description
description: As a next step, please complete the investor questionnaire below, as appropriate.This questionnaire aims to help investors understand their ability to bear investment risks. To protect your legal rights, please fill out this questionnaire truthfully, accurately, and completely. If there are any fraudulent, concealed, or false statements that lead to a mismatch between the survey results and the actual situation, our company will not bear any responsibility.

Relevant knowledge and less than 2 years of experience
